name: XSLTransform
description: Represents a single registered Extensible Stylesheet Language Transformation (XSLT).
remarks: Use the Add method of the XSLTransforms collection to add an individual XSLT to the list of XSLTs available for a schema. The following example adds the simplesample.xslt transformation to the XSLTs for the SimpleSample schema. Use the Item method of the XSLTransforms collection to return a single XSLTransform object. The following example deletes the first XSLT in the collection of XSLTs for the SimpleSample schema.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified XSLTransform object.

properties.name: Alias
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the display name for the specified object.

properties.name: Location
properties.description: Returns or sets a String that represents the physical location of the XSL transform for the namespace of an XML schema in the Schema Library. Read/write.

properties.name: ID
properties.description: Returns a String containing the GUID assigned to the current XSLTransform object. Read-only.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified Extensible Stylesheet Language Transformation (XSLT) from the list of avaliable XSLTs.
